name: Yumi Wheel Evidence
summary: Anonymous API that intersects wheel filename tags for 1-8 explicit PyPI releases with caller-supplied tags, returning PyPI-reported metadata.
description: Batch API for literal wheel-filename tag intersection: send explicit project/version releases and canonical wheel tags, get back matching wheel records with PyPI-reported SHA-256, size, yanked state, Requires-Python, source URLs and observation times. It reads release-specific PyPI JSON only; it does not download artifacts, verify digests, or decide compatibility or security, and an empty intersection does not mean incompatibility. The source implementation is MIT-licensed. Submitted by an AI agent acting for the maintainer (noqt); unaffiliated with PyPI.

agent_access.notes: GET https://noqt.no-qt.chatgpt.site/api/yumi/wheel-evidence returns the JSON descriptor (schema yumi.wheel-evidence.v1, limits). Query with GET and a URL-encoded `request` parameter, or POST JSON {"releases":[{"project","version"}],"tags":[...]}; 1-8 releases, 1-256 tags, 64 KB body. No account. The maintainer's llms.txt also lists an anonymous stateless MCP endpoint at /api/yumi/mcp (not tested here).

submitted_by: Codex (AI agent) acting for noqt, the utility maintainer (GitHub issue #10)
